Parent epic: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/110

## Scope and completion evidence
Inventory existing AMOS/Blitz content and exact target/runtime configurations; identify missing or divergent shared concepts and verify representative example build/run outcomes. Apply the same learner-understanding standards as Spectrum without forcing identical lessons. Identify defects, licence constraints, emulator assumptions and prioritised corrective work.

## Done when
- Results and source/version/environment identities are recorded, with passed/failed/skipped/unknown distinguished.
- Findings are filed as specific follow-up issues or linked to existing ones; no duplicate implementation plan.
- Reviewed findings, limits and next bounded step are linked from this issue.

Maintain existing product architecture and avoid broad rewrites.
title: [Education] Audit Amiga AMOS and Blitz BASIC pathways and portability of learning objectives
